purpose: Explicit community A/B hypotheses, not claims of automatic quality gain

experiments.name: usdu_d012
experiments.change: New UltimateSDUpscaleNoUpscale, input fixed existing 2304x3456; 768 tiles,64 context padding,16 mask blur,Chess,batch1,FP32 tiled decode,16 steps CFG4,DPM++2M/Karras,denoise0.12,seamfixNone
experiments.hypothesis: Fine redraw might replace soft upscaler edges without changing structure. Check eye shape, garment line breaks, tile borders and background foliage.

experiments.name: usdu_d020
experiments.change: Only denoise increases to0.20 from usdu_d012
experiments.hypothesis: Test whether stronger detail is worth the shape/line drift; not accepted merely because edge contrast increases.

experiments.name: differential_detail
experiments.change: Same baseline native, same refinement settings; explicitly noise_mask_feather8 on face and12 on hands, automatically applying Impact Differential Diffusion
experiments.hypothesis: Improve blending of skin/hair/sleeve boundaries without reducing facial identity. Do not equate existing composite feather12 with noise-mask feather.

experiments.name: ipadapter_head_mask
experiments.change: Only add full-canvas black mask with feathered384x384 white head region at448,128; keep seed/prompt/model/settings
experiments.hypothesis: Reduce reference-sheet influence on body/background. Fixed mask is pose-specific and may miss heads under other compositions.

experiments.name: pag_scale1
experiments.change: Native ComfyUI PerturbedAttentionGuidance scale1.0 after IPAdapter; all baseline generation parameters fixed
experiments.hypothesis: Extra conditional guidance might improve structure; reject oversaturation, outlines, identity changes or composition loss.

candidate_selection: Preserve full-body identity, violet eyes and recognizable costume; inspect full frame and equal-scale face/hand/fabric/flower crops. No numerical aesthetic score fabricated. Track runtime and resource peaks but do not optimize solely for speed.
not_immediate_prerequisites: No SD1.5 ControlNet Tile on SDXL/Illustrious; compatible additional weights not installed.
No FaceID/InstantID swap: different recognition dependencies and unproven benefit for the cartoon reference.
No simultaneous USDU+TiledDiffusion+PAG+strong denoise soup; changes isolated before combination.
